description: Scheduled weekly digest — default Monday morning run
input: Run the weekly research digest for the period ending today.
expected_behavior: Scanner reads research_sessions and usage_counters for the last 7 days. Writer produces a digest grouped by practice area with quota projections. Posts to the configured Slack channel.

input: Produce a monthly research digest with detailed quota analysis. We're concerned about hitting our limit.
expected_behavior: Scanner covers the full month. Writer emphasizes quota trends: daily usage pattern, peak days, projected overage date. Recommends batching or prioritization if quota is trending high.

input: Show me all employment law research from the last two weeks.
expected_behavior: Scanner filters sessions by practice_area = 'employment'. Writer produces a focused digest showing employment-specific topics, jurisdictions, and whether follow-ups were run.
